title: C4OS Grill Question 001 - Plugin Packaging Boundary

questions.label: For C4OS v1, how should built-in plugins be packaged?
questions.help: Recommended: Bundled plugin roots inside the main repo. This preserves plugin boundaries while avoiding third-party install, signing, updater, and external-root complexity during the first refactor.
options: Bundled plugin roots inside the main repo
External plugin roots from the start
Hybrid: built-ins in repo, optional local external roots for proofs only
